projectDetails.name: Mantle
projectDetails.description: Mantle is a modular Ethereum Layer 2 network that combines optimistic rollups with a separate data availability layer to reduce costs and improve scalability.

reviews.text: Mantle is a layer-2 blockchain on Ethereum with a modular design for high performance, launched in 2023. It uses optimistic rollups and has its own token for gas. In 2025, it has DeFi and gaming ecosystems with low fees. The team is from BitDAO. It’s growing but still emerging.

Mantle is an Ethereum Layer-2 governed by its DAO (called BitDAO in the past) to focus on banking and finance use cases. It is built on an Optimistic Rollup (OP stack) and is using a modular approach. In 2025 Mantle migrated to EigenDA for data availability and integrated ZK proofs (OP Succinct) for validity, increasing throughput and cutting costs. Mantle maintains a big treasury (over $5 billion in assets, including MNT token and stablecoins) inherited from BitDAO and it partners with exchanges to distribute its token. The network is pushing tokenization and RWA creations with the new Tokenization-as-a-Service tools. Its governance token (MNT) funds grants, ecosystem growth, provides governance and staking rewards

Mantle is an EVM compatible Ethereum layer 2 scaling solution that focuses on modular design and Eigenlayer adoption. Mantle uses optimistic rollup for its consensus mechanism. However, mantle is collaborating with Succinct Labs to use their SP1 zkVM (Zero-Knowledge Virtual Machine) for their future transition to ZK rollup. 
Mantle was founded by an experienced team backed by top tier VCs like Bybit, Pantera Capital, Dragonfly Capital and  Mirana Ventures. The token of the protocol is managed by Mantle DAO which rebranded from BitDAO. Mantle employs strong security measures like multiple third party audits and active bug bounty program with a maximum reward of up to $500,0000.

Mantle appears to be a fast moving Ethereum Layer 2 that’s trying to innovate quickly like merging Optimism’s stack with EigenLayer data availability. I find it intriguing that they’re pushing ZK proofs and even a native stablecoin $MIM. To me it shows potential, but I worry it’s still experimental: the newest architecture adds centralization points like a single operator and DA layer that I watch cautiously. It’s smart, but I’d like to see how decentralized it really is.

Mantle is a Layer2 scaling solution built on Ethereum, designed to improve transaction speeds and reduce costs without compromising on security. It leverages the power of modular blockchain architecture to provide developers with flexibility and scalability. Mantle’s approach aims to combine the best of both worlds: Ethereum’s security and decentralization with faster and cheaper transactions. While still in its early stages, the project has shown promise in optimizing blockchain performance, making it a solid option for dApp developers and users looking for efficient solutions.
